/.title: Make the hero button say where it goes
/.why: Shoppers tap more confidently when a button tells them what they'll see next, rather than a vague 'Order now' on a page with no single product.
/.request: In the top video banner ('Frank's Body Buffet'), change the 'ORDER NOW' button text to 'Shop Holiday Kits' and give it a solid, high-contrast fill so it stands out against the moving video on phones. Add a subtle dark gradient behind the subheading and heading so the text stays readable over every frame of the video.

/.title: Let 'Shop by skin concern' tiles be scanned quickly
/.why: On a phone, a one-at-a-time slider hides most options, so shoppers often never see the concern that matches them.
/.request: In the 'SHOP BY SKIN CONCERN' section on phones, replace the single-card swipe with a horizontally scrolling row of smaller tiles showing about 1.5 cards at once so it is obvious there are more. Alternatively, add a compact row of tappable text chips above the slider listing all seven concerns (Acid: Acne + KP, Tan, Firm + Glow, Barrier Protect, Firm + Restore, Anti-Ageing, Caffeinated, Relax + Recharge) that jump to the matching tile.

/.title: Make each concern tile fully tappable
/.why: Shoppers expect to tap anywhere on a card, and small 'Shop Now' buttons are easy to miss with a thumb.
/.request: Make the whole concern tile (image, heading and description) in 'SHOP BY SKIN CONCERN' a single tap target linking to its collection, and rename each 'Shop Now' button to name the concern, for example 'Shop Barrier Protect'. Keep the capitalisation consistent, as some read 'SHOP NOW' and others 'Shop Now'.

/.title: Show savings clearly on What's Hot cards
/.why: Shoppers judge value faster when the sale price and original price sit side by side in a clear order.
/.request: On the 'WHAT'S HOT' product cards, show the price row as: sale price in bold, the struck-through original price beside it in grey, then the existing percentage tag (for example '$36.00  $60.00  -40%'). Hide the duplicate regular price line so the sale price appears only once.

/.title: Reduce badge clutter on product images
/.why: When every card carries the same badges, they stop helping shoppers tell products apart and cover the product photo.
/.request: On 'WHAT'S HOT' cards, where every product shows both 'New' and 'Kit & Save', combine them into one small badge in the top-left corner (for example 'New kit') so more of the product image is visible on phones.

/.title: Hint the What's Hot carousel scrolls
/.why: Shoppers often miss carousel items unless they can see part of the next card.
/.request: On phones, set the 'WHAT'S HOT' slider to show a partial next card peeking from the right edge, add a 'View all' link beside the heading that goes to /collections/best-sellers, and make the slider arrows large enough to tap easily.

/.title: Confirm Add to cart taps instantly
/.why: Clear feedback reassures shoppers their tap worked so they don't add the same item twice.
/.request: When an 'Add to cart' button on a 'WHAT'S HOT' card is tapped, show the spinner, then briefly change the button text to 'Added ✓' before the 'Item added to your cart' pop-up appears. In the pop-up, make 'Check out' the most prominent button and 'Continue shopping' a plain text link.

/.title: Make the welcome offer easy to act on
/.why: Shoppers ignore offers they can't act on, and an announcement that slides away is hard to tap.
/.request: The announcement 'GET 10% OFF YOUR FIRST ORDER. SIGN UP' currently links to '#'. Point it to the existing sign-up form (for example, scroll to the footer newsletter field or open the sign-up pop-up). Also pause the rotating announcement bar when a shopper touches it so they have time to tap.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Add a short description of the tote
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: Shoppers can't judge a bag they know nothing about, so they hesitate or leave.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: The two text blocks above the price (wt-product__text-block) are empty. Fill the first with a short description using placeholders, for example 'Sturdy canvas tote with a drawstring top, sized for [your bag dimensions], made from [your material]'. Use the second for care notes, for example '[your care instructions]'. Hide any text block that is still empty so it doesn't leave blank gaps.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Move price up under the product name
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: Shoppers on phones want to see the price straight away without scrolling past empty space.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: On mobile, move the price block (#price-template--19083967135919__main) directly under the 'Canvas Tote Bag' heading. Collapse the empty feature-tag rows and the extra separator lines between the heading and the price.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Fix the empty breadcrumb link
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: A blank link looks broken and gives shoppers no way back to related products.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: Remove the empty middle breadcrumb item (the link with an empty href). Leave the trail as 'Home / Canvas Tote Bag', or point the middle item to /collections/all labelled 'Shop All'.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Hide empty sections below the product
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: Blank gaps make the page feel unfinished and push the reviews and related products out of view.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: Hide the features banner, background video, benefits, kit products and before-and-after sections when they have no content. Do the same for the empty brand name span above the h1.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Give the recommendations a clear heading
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: A plain heading tells shoppers what the carousel offers and encourages them to add another item.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: Keep 'LESS PANTS, MORE ME.' as the large heading. Below it, add a small subheading such as 'Pair it with these favourites'. If the recommendations slider has no slides, hide the whole section.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Hide the review tabs when there are no reviews
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: An empty Reviews tab can make shoppers doubt the product, so it's better to show something helpful.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: If the Reviews panel in the bv-reviews section has no content after it loads, open the Q&A tab by default. Alternatively, show the line 'Be the first to review the Canvas Tote Bag' with a button to write a review.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Show the product photo bigger
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: With a single photo, shoppers need to see the bag clearly to judge its size and print.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: Because the gallery has only one image, hide the thumbnail strip and the previous/next arrows on mobile. Let the main image fill the full width, and add a small 'Tap to zoom' hint over it.

/products/canvas-tote-bag.title: Make the quantity control easier to tap
/products/canvas-tote-bag.why: Small plus and minus buttons are easy to mis-tap on a phone.
/products/canvas-tote-bag.request: Enlarge the quantity decrease and increase buttons so each is at least a comfortable thumb-sized square. Give them visible minus and plus symbols, and keep the quantity box on the same row as the Add to cart button.
